long_biography.plain_text:
When a commissioned boat was not delivered as intended, Hüseyin Başaran responded by establishing CMB Yachts in Antalya. The venture gave him a founder's role beyond the family food business, centred on large composite yachts and a market with fewer builders above 40 metres.

The shipyard financed early construction from the group's own resources rather than depending on individual buyers. It combined in-house planning and engineering with international designers, then marketed custom vessels abroad. That willingness to commit capital before a sale helped CMB pursue technically demanding projects and establish a durable Turkish presence in commercial yacht construction.
